DRUID:bear.source: Icy Veins: Feral Druid leveling (shared cat/tank build)

spellMilestones.name: Bear Form
spellMilestones.how: Begin Heeding the Call, then Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus. Finish Body and Heart: summon Lunaclaw east of Auberdine (42,45), then return.

spellMilestones.name: Bear Form
spellMilestones.how: Begin Heeding the Call, then Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. Finish Body and Heart: summon Lunaclaw west of Camp Taurajo (42,60), then return.

spellMilestones.name: Bear Form
spellMilestones.how: Urs'endris in eastern Zephras Isle offers Strength and Mercy. Enter the cave at 53,64 from the north, defeat Ur'endra and return.

spellMilestones.name: Teleport: Moonglade
spellMilestones.how: Accept Moonglade from your capital druid trainer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus or Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. The quest teaches the teleport.

spellMilestones.name: Nature's Grasp
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer; a baseline escape/root ability in Forever, not a talent.

spellMilestones.name: Revive
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer; learn the first rank of the out-of-combat resurrection. Later ranks are at 24, 36, 48 and 60.

spellMilestones.name: Cure Poison
spellMilestones.how: Start Lessons Anew with the capital druid trainer, visit Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade, and finish Power over Poison in Darnassus or Thunder Bluff.

spellMilestones.name: Aquatic Form
spellMilestones.how: Start A Lesson to Learn with the Darnassus/Thunder Bluff druid trainer; follow Dendrite Starblaze, Trial of the Lake and Trial of the Sea Lion in Moonglade.

spellMilestones.name: Cat Form
spellMilestones.how: Follow The Great Cat Spirit through Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade; recover Stormrage Barrow Den relics and finish the chain, including the faction trainer return.

spellMilestones.name: Prowl
spellMilestones.how: Learn the first rank with the Cat Form quest reward. Prowl upgrades are separate ranks at 40 and 60; no level-60 rank is required at level 20.

spellMilestones.name: Omen of Clarity
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer; baseline passive for all specializations. Clearcasting makes an eligible damage/healing spell or offensive ability free; Wrath does not consume it.

spellMilestones.name: Rebirth
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer; first rank of the in-combat resurrection.

spellMilestones.name: Shred
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer after unlocking Cat Form; use from behind the target.

spellMilestones.name: Ferocious Bite
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer; the launch changes added a new rank 1 at level 24.

spellMilestones.name: Remove Curse
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer; removes a curse from an ally.

spellMilestones.name: Abolish Poison
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer; repeat poison removal over a short duration.

spellMilestones.name: Travel Form
spellMilestones.how: Any druid trainer; no class quest is required.

spellMilestones.name: Tranquility
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer; channeled party healing for emergencies.

spellMilestones.name: Poised
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer; learn the passive that discounts the next Energy ability after reaching maximum Energy outside combat.

spellMilestones.name: Frenzied Regeneration
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer; a Bear/Dire Bear emergency self-heal that spends Rage.

spellMilestones.name: Dire Bear Form
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer; upgrade Bear Form for tanking.

spellMilestones.name: Innervate
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer; powerful mana-regeneration cooldown for yourself or an ally.

spellMilestones.name: Hurricane
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer; first rank of the channeled area-damage spell.

spellMilestones.name: Barkskin
spellMilestones.how: Druid trainer; defensive cooldown, usable while shapeshifted in Forever.

notes: Scope: WoW Forever 1.60.1, level cap 60. Talent entries are the guide's ordinary one-point-per-level order for levels 10-60; Legacy bonus talent points are not modeled. Importance scores are addon editorial priorities, not guide ratings.

Talent extraction: read each live guide's data-talentcalculator-pointsurl, preserved its version suffix, and resolved each character with that version's explicit urlId field. Do not decode these hashes against an alphabetically/generated map or the obsolete /json/forever-talent-calculator/druid.json file.

Version-pinned talent sources: feral/bear use https://static.icy-veins.com/r2/icydb/wowf/talents/70755-f7fd84eb/druid.json ; balance/restoration use https://static.icy-veins.com/r2/icydb/wowf/talents/70755-6b631983/druid.json . Calculator implementation: https://static.icy-veins.com/javascript/forever-talent-calculator-b94ba8132c852960488634adf9ed4141.js .

Verification: all 153 distinct source level states were checked in the browser against independently decoded version-pinned orders. Feral was stepped on the live page; blocked caster pages were checked by replaying the exact live calculator HTML/JavaScript with their actual fetched JSON preloaded into the original calculator cache. Every level added exactly one named point, and rank caps/tree prerequisites passed. No archive build was used in the final orders.

Bear intentionally reuses feral leveling, not a separate end-game tank build: the Icy Veins Feral leveling guide explicitly supports switching between DPS and tank roles and improving both Bear and Cat damage. It is not claimed to maximize dedicated tank mitigation.

These are the actual slider orders, not earliest possible talent unlocks: Lacerate 25, Primal Bite 40 and Shifting Power 41 in feral/bear; Insect Swarm 33 and Moonkin Form 53 in balance; Insect Swarm 33, Swiftmend 41, Nature's Swiftness 46 and Wild Growth 58 in restoration. Static milestone tables saying a talent is possible at 25 or 40 do not override the slider.

Lacerate is NOT a level-25 trainer spell at launch. November 2 changes made it a 16-point Feral talent; its level-25 rank is 1328617, level-34 rank 1328616, and 414644 is the level-42 rank. It is covered in talentBuilds and omitted from spellMilestones because kind only permits quest/trainer. Sources: https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/spells/1328617 ; https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/spells/1328616 ; https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/spells/414644 ; https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/news/class-power-and-enemy-hp-increased-in-massive-class-tuning-wow-forever-development-notes-november-2nd/ .

Other talent-granted spells (including Feral Charge, Insect Swarm, Moonkin Form, Swiftmend, Nature's Swiftness, Wild Growth, Primal Bite and Shifting Power) are likewise represented only in talentBuilds, not mislabeled as trainer/quest milestones.

Cat Form unlock is level 20, not 10: the shapeshift-forms article has a conflicting level-10 sentence. The class-quests guide, all leveling guides, Method, spell 768 and the quest chains support level 20. The class-quests article also abbreviates the final trainer return; database quests To Darnassus (98397) and To Thunder Bluff (98362) actually award Cat Form. Sources: https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/druid-class-quests ; https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/druid-shapeshift-forms ; https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/spells/768 ; https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/quests/98397 ; https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/quests/98362 .

Prowl 9913 is the level-60 rank, not the first unlock. The first rank is 5215 at 20, followed by 6783 at 40. The Cat Form teaching spell 1309050 teaches Cat Form 768, Prowl 5215, Claw 1082 and Rip 1079. Sources: https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/spells/1309050 ; https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/spells/5215 ; https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/spells/6783 ; https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/spells/9913 .

Omen of Clarity 16864 is baseline at level 20 despite IcyDB retaining a Talent category label. Its proc is the 15-second Clearcasting aura 16870; Wrath and zero-resource abilities do not consume it. procSpells is deliberately empty: Clearcasting is not a castable reactive ability, so the addon's IsSpellUsable + same-spell cast-success tracker cannot reliably measure its opportunities/consumption. Do not insert 16864 or 16870 as a reactive cast. Sources: https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/spells/16864 ; https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/spells/16870 .

Poised has a similar aura/learned-spell distinction: DRUID passive 1328829 is learned at 32, while 1328827 is its benefit aura. Rogue Poised IDs 1328825/1328826 must not be used for druids. Sources: https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/spells/1328829 ; https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/spells/1328827 .

Race routing: Night Elf uses Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus; Tauren uses Turak Runetotem on Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise. Skyborne can take Strength and Mercy from Urs'endris on Zephras Isle. IcyDB also lists High Order/Windshaper Skyborne in the capital Body and Heart chains (6001/6002), so Body and Heart must not be restricted to NightElf/Tauren by quest name. Sources: https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/quests/6001 ; https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/quests/6002 ; https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/quests/94638 .

Skyborne Cat quests use The Great Windborne Cat Spirit and Avatar of Saeyleenan; the relic trial is in Stormrage Barrow Den, Moonglade, not solely on Zephras Isle. Race-only names here describe quest eligibility; the core forms are available to every druid race. Skyborne is the repository's existing race token; its faction variants were not independently checked with UnitRace. Sources: https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/quests/98404 ; https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/quests/98738 ; https://www.method.gg/wow-forever/wow-forever-druid-leveling-guide-and-talents .

Cure Poison is an additional level-14 quest milestone omitted from the Icy Veins three-form quest article: Lessons Anew leads to Power over Poison (6125 Alliance / 6130 Horde). Aquatic Form starts at 16 for all races, with faction-specific pendant locations. Sources: https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/quests/6125 ; https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/quests/6130 ; https://www.method.gg/wow-forever/wow-forever-druid-leveling-guide-and-talents .

Revive first unlock is 437138 at 12; guide-linked 1237950 and 1237951 are later ranks at 48 and 60. All five listed Revive IDs were checked. Baseline Nature's Grasp, Revive and Omen levels are also stated in Blizzard's druid deep dive, but its old level-42 baseline Lacerate description is superseded by November 2 notes. Source: https://www.wowhead.com/forever/blue-tracker/news/us/world-of-warcraft-forever-class-deep-dives-hunter-and-druid-world-of-warcraft-24301515 .

Confidence caveat: spell IDs and displayed level requirements were checked in the Forever database, not copied from Classic Era. M marks milestones whose trainer delivery or detailed routing was not corroborated with a live trainer/quest interaction. No in-game client interaction was performed; IcyDB is labeled early access and may retain obsolete item-teaching links.
